scope: P32 current selected local PPTX parsed-preview-text search; no NEW-30 and no whole P32/P16/P21 completion
behavior: Only an explicit user selection and start reads current local attachments already declared by loaded messages; it does not load history, connect an Agent or send a prompt.

PPTX MIME essence or the actual local .pptx path selects a parser only; misleading display names do not authorize it, existing DOCX/XLSX/PDF precedence remains, parser failure never falls back to text.

The main-view command captures a complete source with the existing search_source read, full seven-field revision checks, archive inflation/CRC/member validation and actual shared OS slot. Reply cancellation or timeout does not release an unfinished read.

The controller awaits the actual read receipt, snapshots and freezes capture file/parts/entries, and uses the existing real PPTX Worker. The source file is removed before the closed model recheck, while unknown model fields remain rejected.

Only parsed preview strings enter temporary segments. Source-format generated character bullets and spacing may be included; the result is not author-verbatim whole text, source character positions or complete visible text.

Slide, shape, paragraph and break are separate boundaries. Styled runs may join within one valid segment; invalid Unicode is rejected per run before joining. Labels, package keys, metadata, notes, images/OCR and omitted/hidden content are not searched.
Every PPTX scope remains partial, with parsed preview slide count, image omissions and parser warnings. No match is not proof that the full presentation lacks the query.

Source identity is checked before parse, after parse, after a fresh content revision check and before navigation. Actual thread/message/attachment owners and source mutation, scope/query changes, cancellation, hide and late results retain the shared invalidation rules.

limits.parserBudgets: Existing PPTX16MiB archive/64MiB inflated/4MiB text-character/shape/run/image limits remain; search source stays1MiB.

location.ordinals: Preview slide/shape/paragraph/segment are1-based. Preview order is not source-file page numbering.
location.navigation: The existing jump locates the exact originating message attachment node after a fresh file check. It does not automatically open a slide or reinterpret a match as conversation body text.

storage: Ephemeral search projection only; no new persisted body/event ledger, dependencies, environment switches, Agent-specific UI or Agent input capability.
